data.one_liner: A lightweight text and code editor widget for Flutter with syntax highlighting and folding.
data.what_it_does: Re-Editor provides a powerful multi-line text and code editor widget independently implemented for high performance. It supports features like syntax highlighting, line numbers, code folding, scrolling, and search.
use_when: You need a dedicated code or multi-line text editor inside your Flutter app.
You need high performance with large amounts of text compared to standard TextField.
You require custom line numbers, code folding, or syntax highlighting.
avoid_when: You need full IDE-like dynamic syntax analysis and language servers out of the box.
You just need a standard single-line text input field.
strengths: High performance optimization for large texts.
Independent implementation of layout and rendering instead of secondary encapsulation of TextField.
Supports syntax highlighting, search/replace, folding, and custom indicators.
weaknesses: Does not provide default UI for search panels, context menus, or autocomplete views out of the box.
Lacks advanced IDE dynamic syntax analysis.
